This iterative process was carried out for all directors, from Bashford Dean to Bruce Stillman. 4. **Final Compilation:** After confirming that no director appeared to hold the "dean" title based on the search results, the extracted list of directors was compiled into the final chronological answer presented above. **II. The search for "Bashford Dean" was noted to be potentially confounded by his last name, but no positive confirmation of the title was found.
